key: e:digital omnibus on ai regulation eu 2026/1744
synopsis: The corpus reports that the Digital Omnibus on AI, Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, was adopted on 8 July 2026, published in the Official Journal on 24 July 2026 and entered into force on 27 July 2026; it amends the AI Act, aviation regulation and Machinery Regulation [f9796, f2374]. Across chapters, Annex III high-risk obligations are dated to 2 December 2027 and Annex I product-embedded high-risk obligations to 2 August 2028, although one secondary summary instead gives 2 December 2027 for Annex I [f11181, f9797, f2375, f9798, f10310]. Machinery is described as removed from direct AI Act high-risk classification and routed to AI health and safety requirements through Machinery Regulation delegated acts, with the transition tied to 2 August 2028 [f2095, f2377, f15475]. No machinery testing delegated acts had been adopted by October 2026, leaving detailed requirements pending [f2757]. The regulation defines a safety function as preventing or mitigating risks to health, safety or property, and merely integrating AI into a product is insufficient [f2378, f15476]. Source confidence is uneven: Chapter 12 says detailed machinery provisions were not read in the Official Journal, whereas Chapter 3 attributes machinery claims to regulation text and commentary; planners using the booklet after October 2026 are advised to re-check regulatory dates and standards statuses [f10309, f2376, f55].
